from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u055/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-70e7105d.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    top = min(r for r, c in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
    left = min(c for r, c in cells)
    right = max(c for r, c in cells)

    # The 3 frame encloses a blank square containing one 3 marker.
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            out[r][c] = 4
    marker = next((r, c) for r, c in cells
                  if top < r < bottom and left < c < right)
    mr, mc = marker
    inner_top, inner_bottom = top + 1, bottom - 1
    inner_left, inner_right = left + 1, right - 1
    max_radius = max(mr - inner_top, inner_bottom - mr,
                     mc - inner_left, inner_right - mc)
    for radius in range(2, max_radius + 1, 2):
        for r in range(inner_top, inner_bottom + 1):
            for c in range(inner_left, inner_right + 1):
                if max(abs(r - mr), abs(c - mc)) == radius:
                    out[r][c] = 2
    out[mr][mc] = 3
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
ns={}
exec(compile(source, str(program_path), 'exec'), ns)
print(program_path)

def make_input(marker):
    g=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
    for c in range(3,12): g[2][c]=g[10][c]=3
    for r in range(2,11): g[r][3]=g[r][11]=3
    g[marker[0]][marker[1]]=3
    return g

def make_output(interior):
    g=make_input((-1,-1))
    for i,row in enumerate(interior):
        g[3+i][4:11]=row
    return g
